337.canonical: Exercise tools through the connected client session and assert both model-facing text content and machine-readable structuredContent, calling listTools first when schema validation depends on cached tool schemas.

350.canonical: Page every MCP list call with a cursor loop, collecting results until the response has no next cursor rather than assuming the first page is complete.

352.canonical: Use the SDK's built-in ping() for health checks, adding an explicit timeout or deadline when the side being called does not provide one.

353.canonical: Wire progress reporting end-to-end only when requested: the client supplies an onprogress callback/progress token and the server emits progress notifications guarded by that token.

354.canonical: Make long-running calls cancellable end-to-end: the client passes and aborts an AbortSignal, and the server handler polls the signal and stops promptly when cancellation is signalled.

358.canonical: Define and register MCP tool and prompt schemas with JSON Schema 2020-12, directly or through a compatible schema library such as Zod/Standard-Schema.

360.canonical: Use InMemoryTransport for unit, integration, test, and development in-process MCP wiring, reserving stdio, Streamable HTTP, or local server URLs for transport-level or production paths.

377.canonical: Keep agent guidance minimal, judgment-anchored, and non-overlapping across prompts, skills, CLAUDE.md, and user requests, verifying that removed constraints do not hurt behavior.
